purpose: Repeat the real Safari canvas discovery after fixing only the PoC local-server bootstrap. The prior in-process HTTP server was starved by synchronous Atomics waits, so Safari never received the test-owned page. s06 must first prove the loopback page was actually served, then prove NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET, exact local Vision target resolution, real CLICK_POSTED delivery and independent visual postcondition without promoting any Safari caller contract.
requiredClaims: Safari user state is protected: if Safari is already running, execution blocks before evidence creation.
The loopback HTTP server is serviced by the Node event loop and Safari actually requests the test-owned /p6b page before semantic or visual observation begins.
The page requires no external network service and renders PROCEED only into HTML canvas with no accessible fallback text.
A fresh Safari semantic snapshot produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET for PROCEED.
The product-owned local macOS Vision text-region provider is selected through P5D.
P3A remains exact-text-single-match; no fuzzy or normalized product matching is introduced.
The initial visual observation resolves exactly one PROCEED target and FINISHED is absent.
Real Computer Control delivery returns CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.
VERIFIED_SUCCESS requires a fresh independent post-action observation containing FINISHED and no PROCEED.
No built-in Safari visual-fallback caller contract exists or is created by this discovery.
Screenshot bytes, OCR strings and coordinates are not persisted or printed; diagnostics contain only aggregate state/count/distance information.
Pointer, Safari, loopback server, runtime/cache and temporary resources are cleaned up and product trees remain clean.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s06 unchanged, diagnose the next exact boundary and create s07 only after evidence-backed forward-only correction.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned canvas content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payload strings and coordinates remain ephemeral and out of session evidence.
